facts.raw_span: A 30-year-old Asian man presented with a 6-month history of recurrent pain localized to the lateral side of his left knee
slight tenderness and swelling over the lateral joint line without other abnormalities
Plain radiographs were unremarkable
routine laboratory tests were within normal limits
MRI demonstrated a 1.5 cm intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau
the lesion was homogeneous and isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images
the lesion appeared heterogeneous with internal specks on T2-weighted images
the lesion was unremarkable on fat-saturated T2 sequences
Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed enhancement confined to the peripheral rim of the mass
no satellite lesions identified

slight tenderness and swelling over the lateral joint line without other abnormalities
Plain radiographs were unremarkable
routine laboratory tests were within normal limits
MRI demonstrated a 1.5 cm intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau
the lesion was homogeneous and isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images
the lesion appeared heterogeneous with internal specks on T2-weighted images
the lesion was unremarkable on fat-saturated T2 sequences
Gadolinium-enhanced MRI showed enhancement confined to the peripheral rim of the mass
no satellite lesions identified

concepts.why: The presence of a 1.5 cm intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau, with peripheral rim enhancement on Gadolinium-enhanced MRI, is consistent with a Giant Cell Tumor of Bone.
The lesion's heterogeneous appearance with internal specks on T2-weighted images and its location in the epiphysis are suggestive of Chondroblastoma.
The presence of a space-occupying lesion with peripheral rim enhancement on Gadolinium-enhanced MRI, in a young adult, raises the possibility of Synovial Sarcoma.

rationales.F05: Intra-articular space-occupying lesion is suggestive of bone tumors
rationales.F09: Peripheral rim enhancement is characteristic of certain bone tumors
rationales.F03: Unremarkable plain radiographs make aggressive bone lesions less likely
rationales.F10: Absence of satellite lesions decreases the likelihood of malignant tumors like Synovial Sarcoma

frontier_selector.rationale: Chondroblastoma is supported by the heterogeneous appearance with internal specks on T2-weighted MRI images, which is a characteristic feature of this tumor.
